blurb: San Francisco Bay from the water - the way it was meant to be seen. Wine Therapy is a classic 1958 45-foot wooden yacht departing from Pier 39, cruising around the Golden Gate Bridge, circling Alcatraz, and hugging the bay shoreline. NorCal wines, with a full bar. Small groups. Great music. Real San Francisco energy, no boring narration. This isn’t your basic party boat or a ferry - it’s the only floating wine bar
